Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the source’s date “12 June 1516” (and/or “12.06.1516” in day-month format) as “December 6, 1516,” confusing day-month with month-day. They finalized the answer without opening and verifying the Ernest I page and despite the John V page already indicating the year 1516, leading to the incorrect death date.
